scripts.install-all: npm run install:client && npm run install:server
scripts.build:with-sync: node scripts/antigravity-sync.js start-task build && npm run build:client && node scripts/antigravity-sync.js complete-task build success
scripts.test:with-sync: node scripts/antigravity-sync.js start-task test && npm run test && node scripts/antigravity-sync.js complete-task test success
scripts.deploy:with-sync: node scripts/antigravity-sync.js start-task deploy && npm run deploy && node scripts/antigravity-sync.js complete-task deploy success
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.test:e2e: npx playwright test smoke dashboard sidebar_profiles mobile_navigation safety_guard inventory_ops operator_chat profile_management settings --project=chromium
scripts.test:all:e2e: npx playwright test tests/safety_guard.spec.js tests/inventory_ops.spec.js tests/operator_chat.spec.js tests/profile_management.spec.js tests/private_gallery.spec.js tests/settings.spec.js tests/smoke.spec.js tests/dashboard.spec.js tests/mobile_navigation.spec.js tests/sidebar_profiles.spec.js tests/owner_context.spec.js tests/data_transparency.spec.js
scripts.test:pilot: npm run build:client && npm run test:api && npm run test:all:e2e && npm run test:stripe
scripts.test:android:prod: export NODE_ENV=production && npx playwright test tests/android/native_app_smoke.spec.js --config=playwright.android.config.js
scripts.android:sync: cd client && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:android:apk: npm run version:bump && cd client && VITE_APP_VARIANT=relay npm run build && cp dist/index.relay.html dist/index.html && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleNexusRelayDebug
scripts.build:android:full: npm run version:bump && cd client && npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleNexusFullDebug 2>/dev/null || ./gradlew assembleDebug
